calculateStakingLastReward(uint256).notice: If this function returns a nonzero value, call checkpoint in order to get the full reward.

getNextRewardCheckpointTimestamp().notice: Despite the historical function name, this is not a promise that a checkpoint will pay rewards.         While rebaselinePending is true, returns the current block timestamp: a checkpoint can establish         fresh baselines immediately, without allocating rewards or changing accumulated inactivity.         Otherwise returns tsCheckpoint + livenessPeriod, the normal measurement boundary, which may be         in the past. Reward allocation still depends on available funding and service activity eligibility.         Read tsCheckpoint() for the last recorded checkpoint time; subtracting livenessPeriod from this         result does not recover that time while re-baselining is pending.
